# Learnings — ISM Gap Auditor

Read at START of every session. Apply all active entries silently.

**Memory sync**: Check `memory_user_edits` for GA-* entries not in this file.

## Template
### GA-[P|F|D|I][NNN]: [Short title]
- **Class**: Pattern | Fix | Design | Integration
- **Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Context**: What prompted this
- **Learning**: The rule / pattern / fix
- **Apply when**: Trigger condition

## Learning Classes
| Class | Prefix | Covers |
|---|---|---|
| Pattern | GA-P | Reusable detection approach or audit structure |
| Fix | GA-F | Known MCP failure or detection error + resolution |
| Design | GA-D | Output format or report structure decision |
| Integration | GA-I | MCP system behavior or response shape discovery |
